Resolves #21185

Renews `examples/table/container` (`When to Use a Table`, under #21175 / #21142 / #21140) from the six-name selection-picker duplicate into a 14-row managed database specification sheet where one stage-header sentence states when `Neo.table.Container` beats `Neo.grid.Container`, columns visibly size to their content (`Area` < `Specification` < `Starter` < `Notes`), `Notes` wraps multi-line prose, `<thead>` stays sticky on scroll, and the Inspector exposes the table's own switches (`Sortable headers`, `Inline header filters`, `Drag-reorder columns`, `Resizable columns`, `Fit width`) with full `Reset` restoration.

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium E2E across all 4 table specs, 1440×900 and 390×844 light/dark captures, two swapped-order cold-look reads, and local #20679 cover capture) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-6).

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `check-whitespace`, `ticket-archaeology`, `check-file-sizes`, `check-relative-links`, `check-package-contents`, `check-theme-surfaces`, `check-class-module-scope`, `check-engine-brain-boundary`, `check-examples-body-only`, and `pr-body` ran.

### `learn/guides/datahandling/Tables.md` grounding (AC-1)
- Stage sentence (`MainContainer.mjs` `description`): *"Use Neo.table.Container for local tabular data where all records are already present, columns size to their content, and cells wrap — switch to Neo.grid.Container when thousands of rows need virtualization."*
- Supporting guide lines:
  - `learn/guides/datahandling/Tables.md:12`: *"“Tables” here means tabular application data. `Neo.table.Container` is a UI component that can display it."*
  - `learn/guides/datahandling/Tables.md:160-161`: *"A [grid](#/learn/guides/datahandling/Grids) can use the same data-management approach when the presentation needs virtualization."*
  - `learn/guides/datahandling/Tables.md:171`: *"Local data makes the first example easy to reason about: all three records are already present."*

### Four-spec disposition (AC-3)
- `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderInlineProjectionNL.spec.mjs` — **kept unchanged**: replaces `store` and `columns` via Neural Link on mount; needs only a single mounted `Neo.table.Container`.
- `test/playwright/e2e/grid/RowModelModifierClick.spec.mjs` — **adapted in place (no separate fixture needed)**: keeps `id: 'myTableStoreContainer'` and replaces the 4 hardcoded `githubId: 'tobiu'` checks in the Table arm with `String(table.store.getKey(payload.record))` against row 0's `firstRecordId`, matching its own Grid arm (`:41`, `:60`).
- `test/playwright/e2e/table/HeaderResize.spec.mjs` — **adapted in place**: updates header/cell targets from `'Firstname'` / `'Lastname'` / `'Tobias'` to `'Specification'` / `'Area'` / `'Dedicated compute'`, and awaits the `+60 px` resize DOM settle before reading `Area`'s bounding box (`Area` is content-sized at `~82 px` rather than the old `200 px` `min-width`).
- `test/playwright/e2e/table/SortedHeaders.spec.mjs` — **adapted + extended**: updates header targets to `'Specification'` / `'Area'` and adds an assertion covering content-sized column widths, wrapped `Notes` cells, sticky `<th>` on scroll, `Fit width`, and `Reset`.

## Deltas from ticket
- Fixed two pre-existing Inspector bugs in `examples/table/container/MainContainer.mjs`: `dragResortable` lived on `headerToolbar` rather than `TableContainer` (leaving the checkbox unchecked while drag-reorder was active), and `Fit width` wrote `tableLayout: 'fixed'` onto the outer `.neo-table-wrapper` `<div>` rather than the inner `<table>`. Both now target the real surfaces and restore on `Reset`.

  - `390 × 844`: Before `4/10` → After **`7/10`** (**BETTER**) — *"Frame B retains the explanatory guidance, fits three unclipped columns (`Specification`, `Area`, `Starter`) cleanly, and exposes consistent Inspector flags."*
  - *What Reader 1 would change:* *"Add subtle horizontal/vertical scroll affordances and prevent mid-line row clipping (while clamping wrapped `Notes` on narrow viewports) so `Data residency` isn't sliced in half on desktop and the 390px view doesn't render oversized, mostly empty cells."* → **Folded** `td.neo-table-spec-notes { min-width: 300px }` under `@media (max-width: 600px)` before final capture so 4 compact rows fit cleanly at `390 × 844`.

  - `1440 × 900`: Before `4/10` → After **`8/10`** (**BETTER**) — *"Frame X explains when to choose `Neo.table.Container` over `Neo.grid.Container`, fills the viewport with believable infrastructure specification data without header clipping, and exposes clear human-readable controls."*
  - `390 × 844`: Before `5/10` → After **`7/10`** (**BETTER**) — *"Frame X preserves the explanatory header, readable multi-column domain data without clipped headers, and plain-language flag toggles stacked cleanly above the code block."*
